name: 594-pipe
note: a plain scalar ending in a pipe; the next line continues it, so its # is a comment

name: 594-gt
note: the same with a greater-than sign

name: 594-continued-line
doc:
a: x
  y |
  "z # !bwref ghost
b: !bwref x/foo
note: the pipe ends a continuation line

name: 594-own-line-pipe
note: a pipe alone on a continuation line is plain text

name: 560-double
note: a # at the start of a later line of a double-quoted scalar

name: 560-single
note: the same, single-quoted

name: 592-flow
note: a quote closes on a later line inside a flow collection

name: 593-dash-in-plain
note: per-line defect, kept as a control (fixed separately)

name: 578-explicit-key
note: a # in a quoted explicit key in a flow collection

name: 596-indicator-digit
doc:
a: |2
    text
  p: [x
b: ?"y # !bwref ghost
c: !bwref x/foo
note: an indentation indicator; the first content line is deeper than the later ones

name: 596-indicator-digit-2
doc:
a: |2
    first
  b: [x
c: ?"y # !bwref ghost
d: !bwref x/foo
note: the same family with other keys

name: 596-own-line-header
note: the header alone on its line

name: 596-bare-then-shallower
doc:
a:
    x
  [y
b: ?"z # !bwref ghost
c: !bwref x/foo
note: a bare scalar line, then a shallower continuation

name: 596-header-comment-no-blank
doc:
a: |# comment: [x
  text
b: ?"y # !bwref ghost
c: !bwref x/foo
note: a header comment with no blank before the #

name: 596-rejected-marker-mapping
note: go-yaml refuses this document; no scanner result is required

name: limit-block-text-flow
note: known limitation: a flow value inside block scalar text; a scanner that does not track block text lists x/foo

name: limit-block-text-tag
note: known limitation: a tag inside block scalar text; a scanner that does not track block text also lists ghost

name: dash-after-plain-quote
note: a quote after a dash inside a plain scalar opens no quoted scalar, so the # is a comment

name: question-after-plain-quote
note: the same with a question mark

name: tag-then-own-line-quote
note: a plain scalar continued on a more indented line that starts with a quote

name: two-quotes-after-dash
note: two quotes in a plain scalar continuation

name: two-quotes-after-question
note: the same with a question mark

name: bom-at-stream-start
note: a byte order mark at the start of the stream is dropped, so the line is a block sequence entry

name: bom-after-marker
note: a byte order mark after a document marker is not dropped; go-yaml lists no reference (observed, not derived)

name: block-header-comment-with-flow-quote
doc:
a: |# comment: [?"y # !bwref ghost, ignored
  text
b: !bwref x/foo
note: a comment on a block scalar header holds a flow opener and a quote

name: plain-colon-quote-in-flow
note: a colon and a quote after a plain scalar in a flow sequence, the flow continued on the next line

name: verbatim-comma-tag-in-flow
note: a tag is read up to a blank, so it takes the comma, the question mark and the quote that follow it

name: question-in-flow-sequence-entry
note: an explicit key in a flow sequence inside a block sequence entry

name: question-in-flow-sequence-value
note: the first document of issue 578

name: question-in-flow-mapping
note: the second document of issue 578

name: two-boms-before-dash
note: the reader drops the first byte order mark and the scanner skips a second one at the start

name: two-boms-before-flow
note: the same before a flow sequence

name: bom-before-marker
note: the byte order mark takes no column, so the marker still starts at column 0

name: quote-with-ghost-in-block-text
note: block scalar text is text: go-yaml lists no name from it, and the server refuses the document for it

name: digit-in-header-comment
note: a digit in the header comment is no indentation indicator: the block ends at b, so the open quote is block text and carries over nothing

name: header-comment-no-digit
note: control for the digit-in-header-comment case: the same document with a letter in the comment

name: header-digit-and-comment
note: control: a real indentation indicator, then a comment; the text is indented 6, the block ends at b

name: header-digit-then-chomp
note: the indentation indicator before the chomping sign (scannerc.go 2230-2252)

name: header-chomp-then-digit
note: the chomping sign before the indentation indicator (scannerc.go 2204-2228)

name: 616-nbsp-key-column-0
note: a line that starts with U+00A0 has text at column 0: it is a key of its own, so the plain value ends

name: 616-own-line-under-compact-key
note: a tag on its own line under a compact key: the sibling key stands at column 2, so the value ends

name: 616-own-line-under-compact-dash
note: a tag on its own line under a compact dash: the next entry stands at column 2, so the value ends

name: 616-root-bom-before-marker
note: the stream-start byte order mark is no text: the marker is the first line, the tag is a root scalar and goes on (review of the 616 change)

name: 616-root-crlf-marker
note: a marker line that ends in a CRLF is a marker: the tag is a root scalar and goes on (review of the 616 change)

name: 616-anchor-only-line-is-no-parent
note: a line that holds only an anchor is no parent: the value belongs to k at column 0, and the next line at column 1 goes on (review of the 616 change)
